text: `(*Command).Flags()` returns the complete applicable `FlagSet`, covering flags declared locally plus persistent flags declared on the command and its parents (`command.go:1641-1653`). It lazily creates the set with `ContinueOnError` and directs flag errors to the command's buffer. `LocalNonPersistentFlags` filters that set to flags that do not persist to children (`command.go:1655-1666`).
